1 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:33: interpolation reads `node` → "Delete the row"
description: A sentence handed to a tree a template draws of itself: the outlet inside it hands each child back to it, a child being an item of what the variable stands for. A read following the names without end never returns, and one that counts a node a name stands for as a literal finds two.
